benchmark_exclusion_reason: Requires the model-owned five-frame public C ABI

testcases.name: sam2-public-core-l0
testcases.notes: Secretless L4 premerge smoke: build the six real TensorRT plans from the pinned public SAM2.1 small core plus a deterministic lazy bbox overlay, then run the public five-frame C ABI without checked-in model, bundle, input, or golden artifacts. This case does not assess semantic accuracy; sam2-l4-local retains the externally provisioned L3 accuracy contract.
